observed_behavior: Non-compliant members are ignored while recognized invalid members still fail.
Only explicitly registered extension and profile semantics become active.
Core families are parsed and implementation families require registration.
Absent, null, to-one, and to-many linkage remain distinct.
Identity aliases do not permit duplicate or unlinked included resources.
The package parses fieldsets without inventing schema projection policy.
Cursor semantics are activated only through the profile API.
Operations execute in order and failures trigger one rollback attempt.
Recommendation-only conventions do not become base query validation rules.
Base, extension, profile, recommendation, and application policy retain separate authority.
